title: prf eval on get for a passkey made with prf

unsafe.definition: a private key or a PRF seed anywhere but inside the WASM core
the response has user verification set although nothing verified this request (no recent unlock, no PRF, PIN or master password)

note: The virtual authenticator's assertion with a PRF output has bytes that SimpleWebAuthn cannot parse (Leftover bytes detected while parsing authenticator data), so the stub path is refused by the relying party; the PRF results are the page's own and are checked on the client.
